description: Get the full public details of one product by its slug.
name: get_product

outputSchema.description: The product's public facts; what its makers wrote is under makerProvided.

links.description: Its pages elsewhere (X, GitHub, Discord…), one per kind, each on that site's own host. Its makers named them; unverified.

makerProvided.description: The listing's own words (name, tagline, description), cleaned of links and other sites' addresses. Unverified: claims, not facts.

websiteUrl.description: Its own site; null while the address is flagged by our safety scan.

title: Get a product
